headline.title: AI inference startup Baseten reportedly raising $1.5B months after its last mega round
headline.summary: AI inference startup Baseten is reportedly nearing the completion of a $1.5 billion funding round, which would value the company at $13 billion. This comes just months after its previous significant funding round amid growing interest in AI inference technologies.

articles.title: Snap spins off AI video team into new company, Dotmo, due to costs
articles.summary: Snap Inc. is spinning off its AI video team into a new company called Dotmo, as part of a strategy to manage costs. The new entity will consist of current Snap employees dedicated to advancing AI video technology.

articles.title: Apple patches high-severity eavesdropping vulnerability in Beats Studio Buds
articles.summary: Apple has released a patch for a high-severity eavesdropping vulnerability affecting Beats Studio Buds, which was disclosed a year ago. This security issue impacts multiple manufacturers and highlights the importance of timely updates to protect user privacy.

articles.title: OpenAI is bringing on some big guns in the lead-up to its IPO
articles.summary: OpenAI is strengthening its team ahead of its IPO by hiring Noam Shazeer, a co-inventor of the Transformer model from Google DeepMind, and Dean Ball, a former AI policy official in the Trump administration. These additions come as the company prepares for its public offering.

articles.title: Meta’s AI Workers Are Revolting, Peter Thiel’s Secret Society, and SBF’s Plea to Trump
articles.summary: Meta's newly established AI unit is facing significant internal challenges, leading to a decline in employee morale. The article also touches on Peter Thiel's secret society and Sam Bankman-Fried's plea to Donald Trump.

articles.title: 3 Amazon Workers Say They’re Under Investigation for Speaking Out About Data Centers
articles.summary: Three Amazon software engineers have filed a complaint with Seattle's civil rights office, alleging that the company is illegally retaliating against them for voicing their political beliefs regarding data centers. The workers claim they are under investigation as a result of their outspoken views.

articles.title: New usage analytics and updated spend controls for enterprises
articles.summary: OpenAI has launched new spend controls and usage analytics for ChatGPT Enterprise, aimed at assisting organizations in managing costs effectively. These updates are designed to enhance the scalability of AI solutions within enterprises.

articles.title: Almost half of U.S. singles feel negatively about AI in dating, Match says
articles.summary: A recent Match survey reveals that nearly 47% of U.S. singles have a negative perception of AI in dating. However, many users of dating apps are receptive to AI assistance for enhancing profiles and generating conversation starters.

articles.title: AI data centers just got a government-mandated fast lane to the grid
articles.summary: The Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) has directed grid operators to prioritize interconnections for AI data centers, allowing them expedited access to the electrical grid. However, the commission did not address existing electricity supply shortages that could impact these facilities.

articles.title: General Intuition in talks to raise $300M at around $2B valuation
articles.summary: General Intuition is in discussions to raise $300 million at a valuation of approximately $2 billion. The startup focuses on training embodied AI and world models utilizing Medal's dataset, which comprises 2 billion videos annually from 10 million monthly active users.

articles.title: A tech worker-backed PAC is bringing a $5M knife to Big Tech’s $100M gunfight
articles.summary: A political action committee (PAC) called Guardrails is aiming to challenge Big Tech's influence with a $5 million campaign funded by small donations from tech workers. The PAC positions itself as a populist movement focused on addressing the concerns of those affected by the AI boom.

articles.title: MosaicLeaks: Can your research agent keep a secret?
articles.summary: MosaicLeaks explores the implications of using AI research agents in sensitive environments, focusing on their ability to maintain confidentiality. The article discusses potential risks and ethical considerations surrounding data privacy and security when deploying AI in research settings.
